frames.origin: Cartographer first laser initialization; x/y axes inherited from first laser pose

initialization.note: Before first optimized pose is unestimated; no unsupported fixed warm-up duration is assumed.

reliability.limitation: Heuristic scan-plane consistency audit; missed failures, glass, occlusion and doubled walls remain possible. This does not certify map correctness.

revisits.limitation: Camera-gated scan registration checks reuse sensor data; held-out added constraints are not independent ground truth. Registration residual is not reference uncertainty.

physical_reference.reason: No independently measured distances/checkpoints with uncertainty are supplied in the recordings.
